usedFor: Modern Events Calendar publishes events, and each “New Event” adds a record in Airtable.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in Modern Events Calendar, then “Create Record” in Airtable
bestTemplate.why: Each new event gets a row in your base, so planning happens next to the listing.

watchOut: “Update Record” in Airtable creates a record when no match is found, so check your matching field.
